verdict.rationale: dLocal's docs say the platform settles funds globally, offers settlements, and that the dashboard lets you track transactions and access detailed reports. That counts as glancing first-party support for settlement reporting. Nothing in the evidence describes reconciliation against bank deposits or report line items. Missing for 10: documented settlement or reconciliation reports matched to bank deposits, itemized fee, refund and chargeback breakdowns, report export formats or API access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
